title: [GMCP 203.013.06] Operations and evidence: MRTR, elicitation, sampling, and roots interaction model
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-013-06. Ship inspectable CLI, TUI or API state, configuration validation, bounded metrics/logs/traces, diagnostics, examples, migration and rollback guidance, incident runbooks, and reproducible evidence artifacts. Automate drift detection so a changed dependency or standard invalidates stale proof. Vector outcome: The model-request/tool-response flow fully implements input_required, typed inputRequests, retry with inputResponses, nested elicitation, sampling and roots compatibility, cancellation, deadlines, progress, partial failure, and explicit handle ownership. Every human or model decision is attributable, policy-checked and resumable, and replays cannot duplicate side effects or hijack another principal's handle. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
